scope: AKMM Chapter 6 (pp. 159-186) and Appendix 6.A (pp. 838-839): the First Welfare Theorem in the abstract economy and with infinitely many goods, Negishi weights and the Pareto frontier, inefficiencies (taxes, a production externality, a borrowing constraint, monopolistic competition), consumption-equivalent welfare and the veil of ignorance, overlapping-generations efficiency (finite-value welfare theorem, stationary Balasko-Shell, storage), Theorem 6.2 (the Cass criterion under fn. 12's bounds), Theorem .5 and dynamic inefficiency in the warm-glow model.
source: Marina Azzimonti, Per Krusell, Alisdair McKay and Toshihiko Mukoyama, Macroeconomics (draft of December 2025), Chapter 6 and Appendix 6.A
